messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Heather Lawson <heather.lawson@medsphere.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP kickoff & CS handoff — Implementation milestones and owners for MedSphere

Hi Heather & Jamal —

Congrats again on getting the agreement across the finish line. As discussed on our signature call, this thread is the mutual action plan (MAP) kickoff and handoff to Customer Success so we can synchronize timelines, owners, and the immediate onboarding deliverables. Attached is a compact MAP (MedSphere_MAP_v1.2.pdf) and a draft SOW that contains the milestones we expect to align on during the evaluation and initial rollout.

High-level proposed timeline (please confirm):
- Week 0 (this week): SOW review and PO/payment routing
- Week 1: Kickoff meeting with CS + technical discovery (KV/cache, data flows)
- Weeks 2–3: Sandbox deployment + initial eval plan (sample prompts, performance baselines)
- Weeks 4–6: Pilot run and SLA tuning; handoff to product team for scale

Owners (suggested):
- Sales / commercial lead: Karthik Iyer (me) — contract / billing coordination
- Customer Success lead: Monica Patel — onboarding/project lead
- Technical implementation: Laura Bennett — infra/config and runtime tuning
- Executive sponsor (Redwood): Rishi Malhotra — escalation & SLA signoff

Next steps for this week:
1) Heather/Jamal: confirm the PO timeline and the appropriate procurement contact (cc'd procurement@medsphere.com OK?)
2) Internal: Monica — can you confirm availability for a 60-minute kickoff Thursday or Friday (PST)?
3) I'll upload the SOW to DocuSign once we agree on minor edits and confirm PO path.

Attachments: MedSphere_MAP_v1.2.pdf (MAP workbook), SOW_Draft_MedSphere_20261129.docx

Thank you — excited to get started.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

--
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference platform for predictable, economical LLM serving

- PO: We are targeting to route the PO by Friday 12/04. I'll confirm with procurement and loop them into the DocuSign step.

Hi Heather, Jamal —

Thanks Karthik. Hi team — Monica here, I'll be leading the onboarding from Redwood's side. Short note on the plan and what I need from you before the kickoff on Thursday: 

1) Kickoff agenda (60 min): introductions, success criteria, security checklist, sandbox access plan, data/sample handoff (who, what, format), and next 30-day milestones.
2) Pre-kickoff asks (if you can share ahead of the meeting):
   - One sample dataset (CSV/JSON) + approximate record counts (Heather noted you'll provide)
   - SOC 2 report or pointer (Priya, please share SSO/SCIM requirements and any IP restrictions)
   - Names + emails for 2 technical contacts who will be assigned to configuration work (devops/infra)
3) Sandbox: We'll provision a read-only sandbox and a short eval script that measures latency, token costs, and output quality against the sample prompts you provide. Expect the sandbox link 24–36 hours after kickoff.
4) Pilot acceptance checklist (we'll draft and share during kickoff): functional criteria, latency targets, token-cost budget, and handover criteria to production.

I'll send calendar invites for Thu 12/03 11:00 AM PST with a link to a short pre-read (MAP + SOW summary). Looking forward to meeting everyone.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0310
